title: Avoiding Bacterial Contamination of Clean Catch Urine Cultures in Ambulatory Patients in the Emergency Department
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to find the best cleaning and collection methods to obtain a 'non-contaminated' clean catch mid-stream urine sample to diagnose suspected urinary tract infection (UTI).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of older
* Urine culture order by physician

Exclusion Criteria:

* Under 18 years of age
* Urinary catheter in place
* Not ambulatory
study_population: Ambulatory patients in the Emergency Department at an Academic Medical Center with a physician order for a urine culture. Patient must be able to self-obtain the urine culture.
